summary: Refactor verification (monolith 3228-line server.py -> 14 router modules + deps.py + cms_defaults.py + seed.py + cron_jobs.py, slim 101-line server.py). Backend boot clean: GET /api/health=ok, APScheduler 'Scheduler started' with both jobs (check_subscription_expiry_job, check_contract_expiry_job) registered and executing. Full Phase 2+3+4+5+6 pytest regression suite: 100 passed / 1 intentional skip (PPR cover-upload constraint) / 0 failures (same 100/101 result as pre-refactor). Added new /app/backend/tests/test_refactor_smoke.py with 14 targeted tests covering refactor-specific risks: health, super_admin + 4 sub_admin logins, register+logout, all 12 CMS landing keys, 5 admin endpoints (dashboard/labels/releases/artists/payments), cron-trigger role matrix (super_admin + finance OK on subscription-check; super_admin + release OK on contract-check; wrong-role 403), label dashboard redaction of royalty_percentage_default/history/default_royalty_share, withdraw window, notifications shape, AND specifically the cross-label release isolation that proves the label_user_ids -> label_uids rename in releases.py admin action did not break anything. Result: 14/14 PASS. Zero refactor regressions detected.

APScheduler properly initialized in cron_jobs.start_scheduler() and shut down in stop_scheduler(); verified in /var/log/supervisor/backend.err.log on every restart cycle during testing.

All notify/notify_many/admin_user_ids/label_user_ids helpers moved to deps.py — no duplicate definitions remain; ticket-comment notification tests and contract-creates-notification tests both pass, confirming the moved helpers wire correctly.

Carry-over (not refactor-related): SUBSCRIPTION_PRICES constant + CMS pricing block remain two sources of truth; PATCH /api/admin/labels/{id} still does not accept subscription_tier (low-priority, pre-existing).
